title: Wonderful Crispy Middle Eastern Vegetable Spring Rolls
description: Fresh and crispy Middle Eastern spring rolls filled with vegetables, perfect for a healthy snack or meal prep, featuring egg roll wrappers and an emulsified sauce for a raw-friendly flavor boost.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine grated cucumber, carrots, zucchini, and diced red bell pepper.
In a small bowl, mix hummus with sumac and salt.
Lay an egg roll wrapper on a flat surface and brush edges with water.
Place about 1 tablespoon of the vegetable mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Drizzle a small amount of the hummus mixture over the vegetables.
Fold the bottom half of the wrapper over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrapper to form a tight cylinder.
Repeat with remaining wrappers and filling.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and fry the spring rolls until crispy and golden brown.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
